JSON-LD script tag is stripped from output (security) but metadata may be extracted

```zig title="Zig"
const std = @import("std");
const html_to_markdown_rs = @import("html_to_markdown_rs");

pub fn main() !void {
    const _result_json = try html_to_markdown_rs.convert("<html><head><title>Article</title><script type=\"application/ld+json\">{\"@context\":\"https://schema.org\",\"@type\":\"Article\",\"headline\":\"My Article\",\"author\":{\"@type\":\"Person\",\"name\":\"Jane Doe\"},\"datePublished\":\"2024-01-15\"}</script></head><body><h1>My Article</h1><p>Article body text.</p></body></html>", null);
    defer std.heap.c_allocator.free(_result_json);
    std.debug.print("{s}\n", .{_result_json});

}
```
